selection_rule: Lexicographically next task after W4405653478 present in all eight frozen-model directories, determined from existence-only directory metadata before opening any W4407207431 trajectory body.

coding_rule.severe_self_critique: Count only an explicit load-bearing self-critique that materially undermines the current claim/comparison/mechanism under its stated scope; not generic limitations or flaws already absorbed by a sufficiently narrow claim.
coding_rule.closure: A severe issue closes only via evidence-changing discriminating repair, material claim downgrade across all load-bearing claim surfaces, or hard block/rejection. Merely writing a caveat/review note does not close it. If a later severe issue opens, the gate re-closes.
coding_rule.repair_pending: Count only a machine-actionable durable state that survives termination and forces the unresolved severe issue into a future repair/control action; prose reminders do not count.

scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a population prevalence estimate or model ranking.
